name: TerrainStep
lead: One populate step of the overworld, as citadel.yml writes it, read from `game.terrain.steps`.

fields.name: block
fields.description: The block a clay, ore or patch step places.

fields.name: fluid
fields.description: The fluid a springs step places: "water" or "lava".

fields.name: count
fields.description: How many tries, veins, blobs, clumps or springs the step makes in a chunk.

fields.name: size
fields.description: How long each clay blob or ore vein is.

fields.name: below
fields.description: An ore step places its veins below this y.

fields.name: bonus
fields.description: Trees: one chunk in this many gets one more tree.

fields.name: big
fields.description: Trees: one chunk in this many grows big trees instead of small ones.

fields.name: chance
fields.description: Patch: made one time in this many, in place of `count` times.

fields.name: bound
fields.description: Springs: the y is picked below this bound before `nesting` pushes it deeper.

fields.name: nesting
fields.description: Springs: how many times the y is picked again below itself; lava's 2 keeps it deeper than water's 1.

title: TerrainStep type
